notes.title: supports Steam feature, "Remote Play Together"!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36222652/a4d065c138e6e5406ccdde62bd883672aecdfd30.png[/img]

《DUMB FIGHT》supports Steam brand new feature, the "Remote Play Together"!

Even though 《DUMB FIGHT》 does not have an online multiplayer feature, but you are able to play with faraway friends at home through the "Remote Play Together" function supported by Steam.

All you need is one pack of 《DUMB FIGHT》, friends can play with you remotely.

For more detail, please look at the Steam official introduction.
*Remind: This feature is provided by Steam officially.

[h2][b]Steps to Remote Play with friends[/b][/h2]

[h1][b]1.Launch DUMB FIGHT[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]2.Invite Friend[/b][/h1]
1.Use Shift+Tab to call out the Steam embedded interface
2.View friends
3.Right-click on your online friend
4.Send remote play invitation
5.Wait for friend's acceptance

[h1][b]3.Enjoy DUMB FIGHT with your friend[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]※Please be aware[/b][/h3]
When using Remote Play, the keyboard of the main host (the computer that owns and launch the game) will be shared with other remote players. To enable more than one player using the same keyboard, please modify each one's control access to a different key position. (A keyboard supports 4 players)


Please look at here for more information (From Steam official)：
https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687
